settings.heading: What Are Monthly Bangers?
settings.text_1:
Monthly Bangers is a very personal space within Perito Moreno￼. It was born from my desire to create perfumes without fear, without fixed rules, and without the pressure of making something “commercial.” Every month, I sit in the studio and create purely from instinct, emotion, memory, and obsession toward raw materials. Most of these perfumes are made in extremely small quantities, often from a single vessel, which means once the batch is finished, it may never smell exactly the same again. Some creations return years later in a different form, while some remain memories shared only by the few people who experienced them.

Monthly Bangers is not about mass production. It is about preserving the soul of artistic perfumery in its rawest form. Sometimes the fragrances are comforting, sometimes dark, sometimes challenging, but every single bottle carries a piece of my journey as a perfumer. This project has slowly become a living diary written through scent, month after month, together with a beautiful community that truly understands creativity, patience, and craftsmanship. To everyone who has supported Monthly Bangers, waited for launches, shared emotions, and worn these creations with love, thank you from the bottom of my heart for allowing this dream to grow into something so special.
